chunks: Say: 'O men, I am verily the apostle of God to you all. His whose kingdom extends over the heavens and the earth. There is no god but He, the giver of life and death. So believe in God and the messenger, the gentile Prophet, sent by Him, who believes in God and His messages. Obey him; you may haply be guided aright.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Prophet being called 'Al-Ummi' in this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the universality of Prophet Muhammad’s (SAWW) mission, extending beyond the Children of Israel to all of humanity. The title 'Al-Ummi' is interpreted not merely as 'unlettered' but as one who knows the Book by divine intuition rather than formal schooling, affirming his unique spiritual authority. This call to follow him is seen as the primary means to attain true guidance (hidayah), linking the concept of prophetic succession with universal monotheism.
